name: Selman Marrakech
insider_take: Where Andalusian elegance meets modern luxury in Morocco's most captivating city
whats_special: Selman Marrakech is home to one of the world's most exceptional Arabian horse collections, with over 50 purebred horses that guests can admire and ride. The property features stunning traditional Moroccan architecture with intricate zellige tilework and carved cedar ceilings, while offering contemporary amenities like a world-class spa and multiple gourmet restaurants.
pro_tip: Book a sunset horseback ride through the hotel's private grounds - it's an exclusive experience that showcases both the magnificent Arabian horses and breathtaking views of the Atlas Mountains.
dont_miss: The hotel's incredible equestrian shows featuring their prized Arabian horses, the authentic hammam experience at the spa, and dining at their rooftop restaurant with panoramic views of Marrakech's medina and the snow-capped Atlas Mountains beyond.
pros: Stunning palatial architecture with traditional Moroccan design
World-class spa featuring authentic hammam treatments
Multiple exquisite dining venues with international cuisine
Exceptional service with personalized attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Located outside central Marrakech medina area
